title.en: Vaazhiya Nilane (வாழிய நிலனே) — a poem on the land

text.en: A poet wishes long life to the land and its people.

This poem in the unit on the country and society praises the land (நிலம்) and wishes it to flourish. It follows the Sangam habit of blessing a good king and his country with the wish that the land may live long.
The poem links the prosperity of a nation to the goodness of its rulers and people. Read the poem from the textbook and learn its meaning.
Terms: நிலம் (land), வாழ்த்து (blessing), அரசு (government) and நாடு (country). The exact lines are best learnt from your textbook.
